summary: Cheniere Energy Partners, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a private placement of $1 billion 5.350% Senior Notes due 2036 and $750 million 6.050% Senior Notes due 2056. The notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with existing unsubordinated debt, issued under a base indenture and supplemental indentures with The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. Interest is payable semi-annually. This is an ordinary debt financing transaction, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other special-situation elements. The filing reflects routine capital markets activity.
